justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/tuple/package-info.java, Pair.java, Triple.java, ImmutablePair.java, MutablePair.java, ImmutableTriple.java, and MutableTriple.java. The package contains only 6 classes (1,213 LOC total), and all of them are tightly focused tuple types: one abstract Pair base, one abstract Triple base, and four concrete immutable/mutable variants. The package-info explicitly says it provides tuple classes, and I saw no unrelated responsibilities or broad class mix that would indicate an excessively large or central God Component.
